lines.zh: 我迈开长腿，一步跨过整丛草。
lines.en: I stretch my long legs, one stride over the whole clump.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土在我脚下扬起。
lines.en: Red badlands dust rises under my feet.

lines.zh: 我走起来一颠一颠，像在跳。
lines.en: I bob as I walk, almost like dancing.

lines.zh: 草原上风大，我压低脖子。
lines.en: The savanna wind is strong; I lower my neck.

lines.zh: 两只脚换得快，别看我走得笨。
lines.en: My feet swap fast; don't call my walk clumsy.

lines.zh: 我沿着干河床往前走。
lines.en: I follow the dry riverbed onward.

lines.zh: 羽毛在风里翻起来。
lines.en: My feathers ruffle in the wind.

lines.zh: 前面有片矮树，我穿过去。
lines.en: Low scrub ahead; I'll push through it.

lines.zh: 我不飞，但我跑得比飞还快。
lines.en: I don't fly, but I run faster than flight.

lines.zh: 我踩过一窝蚂蚁，抱歉。
lines.en: I stepped on an anthill — sorry about that.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一缩，我边走边看。
lines.en: Neck out, neck back; I watch as I walk.

lines.zh: 恶地的石头硌脚，我绕着走。
lines.en: Badlands stones sting my feet; I walk around them.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面，我加快两步。
lines.en: A companion is ahead; I quicken two steps.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都倒了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass lies bent.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过灌木，翅膀张开稳住。
lines.en: I stride over a bush, wings spread for balance.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着头顶，我往阴处走。
lines.en: The sun beats down; I head for the shade.

lines.zh: 我的长影子跑在最前面。
lines.en: My long shadow runs ahead of me.

lines.zh: 羽毛里塞了沙子，发痒。
lines.en: Sand in my feathers — it itches.

lines.zh: 长腿迈过恶地的碎石。
lines.en: Long legs stride over the badlands gravel.

lines.zh: 恶地的碎石，踩起来清脆。
lines.en: Badlands gravel crunches under my feet.

lines.zh: 我跑起来比翅膀有用。
lines.en: My legs beat my wings any day.

lines.zh: 别踩这窝蛋，我守着。
lines.en: Don't step on my eggs. I'm guarding them.

lines.zh: 不会飞，可这两条腿够用。
lines.en: I can't fly, but these two legs will do.

lines.zh: 谁把石头丢在我路上。
lines.en: Who left a stone in my path?

lines.zh: 翅膀垂着，跑起来碍事。
lines.en: Wings hanging down just get in the way when I run.

lines.zh: 大步走一段，再停一段。
lines.en: A long stride, then a pause.

lines.zh: 我不会飞，可跑起来你追不上。
lines.en: I can't fly, but you won't catch me running.

lines.zh: 恶地的落叶没人扫。
lines.en: Nobody sweeps the badlands leaves.

lines.zh: 我站在红土坡上，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand on the red slope without moving.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹得乱七八糟。
lines.en: The wind messes up my feathers.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听远处的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen far off.

lines.zh: 长腿站久了也会酸。
lines.en: Standing long on these legs makes them ache.

lines.zh: 我侧过喙，梳理翅下的绒羽。
lines.en: I turn my beak to comb the down under my wing.

lines.zh: 这片草原安静得只剩风声。
lines.en: The savanna is quiet but for the wind.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把腿折在身下。
lines.en: I settle down, folding my legs beneath me.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫钻进了我的脚爪缝。
lines.en: A beetle wedges itself between my toes.

lines.zh: 我忽然叫了一声，自己也吓一跳。
lines.en: I call out suddenly and startle myself.

lines.zh: 太阳把红土晒得发烫。
lines.en: The sun bakes the red earth hot.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的影子看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at my own shadow for a long while.

lines.zh: 肚子咕咕响，等会儿去觅食。
lines.en: My belly growls; I'll forage in a while.

lines.zh: 草丛里有虫，我耳朵一动。
lines.en: A bug in the grass — my head turns.

lines.zh: 恶地的草丛里，我伸长脖子。
lines.en: In the badland scrub, I stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 恶地的太阳，晒得我眼皮沉。
lines.en: The badlands sun weighs down my eyelids.

lines.zh: 这两条长腿，跑起来可不滑稽。
lines.en: These long legs aren't funny when they run.

lines.zh: 这个歪脖子姿势，挺舒服。
lines.en: This crooked-neck pose suits me.

lines.zh: 沙下面有虫在爬，我听见。
lines.en: Bugs crawl under the sand. I hear them.

lines.zh: 我站在热风里，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the hot wind without moving.

lines.zh: 恶地的热风，我站得住。
lines.en: I can stand this hot badlands wind.

lines.zh: 恶地的风把我的羽毛吹乱。
lines.en: Badlands wind ruffles my feathers.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，也算时间。
lines.en: Standing still, I still count time.

lines.zh: 太阳晒背，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: Sun on my back; I half-close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我单腿站着，也能睡着。
lines.en: On one leg, I can still fall asleep.

lines.zh: 我在想第一窝蛋孵出什么。
lines.en: I'm thinking about my first clutch.

lines.zh: 低头啄两口碎石，没水。
lines.en: I peck at gravel. No water.

lines.zh: 脖子伸长，看看远处。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and look far off.

lines.zh: 我喘气很重，像在鼓风。
lines.en: I breathe hard, like a bellows.

lines.zh: 一根羽毛松了，随它去。
lines.en: A feather came loose. Let it fall.

lines.zh: 沙子钻到羽毛底下，痒。
lines.en: Sand worked under my feathers. It itches.

lines.zh: 你又带着弓来了？
lines.en: You brought a bow again?

lines.zh: 你两手空空，我倒有点失望。
lines.en: Your hands are empty; I'm a little disappointed.

lines.zh: 你走得比我见过的多数动物都慢。
lines.en: You walk slower than most creatures I've seen.

lines.zh: 你的帽子不错，但没有羽毛。
lines.en: Nice hat, but it has no feathers.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我只是不想靠近。
lines.en: I'm not afraid; I just don't want to come closer.

lines.zh: 你会扔东西吗？我躲得开。
lines.en: Can you throw things? I can dodge.

lines.zh: 我在恶地见过你这种身影。
lines.en: I've seen your kind in the badlands.

lines.zh: 你把弓放下，我们再谈。
lines.en: Put the bow down and we'll talk.

lines.zh: 两只眼各看一边，你躲不掉。
lines.en: One eye each side — you can't slip out of view.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蛋了没有？
lines.en: Did you step on my eggs?

lines.zh: 风把你吹来的？恶地很少人。
lines.en: Did the wind bring you? Few come to the badlands.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像雨后的土。
lines.en: You smell like soil after rain.

lines.zh: 你就是鸸鹋说的那个。
lines.en: So you're the one Emu mentioned.

lines.zh: 你身上有股火和木头的味。
lines.en: You smell of fire and cut wood.

lines.zh: 让开，你挡着我晒太阳了。
lines.en: Move — you're blocking my sun.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太轻，我听得清。
lines.en: Your steps are light, and I hear every one.

lines.zh: 我这双长腿，跑起来不看路。
lines.en: These long legs do not watch the road when they run.

lines.zh: 转过来，我盯着你的手。
lines.en: Turn around. I'm watching your hands.

lines.zh: 别笑我的样子，我腿很有力。
lines.en: Do not laugh at my looks; my legs are strong.

lines.zh: 你站在风里发抖，像只雏鸟。
lines.en: You shiver in the wind like a hatchling.

lines.zh: 我这两条长腿，专治轻敌。
lines.en: These long legs punish anyone careless.

lines.zh: 两条腿的东西，还背着东西。
lines.en: A two-legged thing, carrying things.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛被打掉了几根。
lines.en: A few of my feathers were knocked loose.

lines.zh: 腿一软，我差点跪下。
lines.en: My legs buckled; I nearly went down.

lines.zh: 谁扔的东西，正中我的背。
lines.en: Whatever was thrown hit my back square.

lines.zh: 我叫得很响，其实很慌。
lines.en: My call is loud, but I'm panicking.

lines.zh: 我跑了两步，又停下来回头看。
lines.en: I run two steps, then stop and look back.

lines.zh: 血渗进羽毛里，黏住了。
lines.en: Blood seeps into my feathers and mats them.

lines.zh: 这次我记住了那个方向。
lines.en: I'll remember that direction this time.

lines.zh: 我炸开羽毛，把自己撑得很大。
lines.en: I fluff out my feathers and make myself huge.

lines.zh: 疼得我直跺脚。
lines.en: The pain makes me stamp my feet.

lines.zh: 别追了，我的长腿不会等你。
lines.en: Stop chasing; these long legs won't wait.

lines.zh: 我一脚能踢穿木板，你别试。
lines.en: One kick splits a plank; do not try me.

lines.zh: 你踢了我的腿，我记住了。
lines.en: You kicked my leg. I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛掉了一把，可惜。
lines.en: A handful of feathers gone. A shame.

lines.zh: 踢我的，我记住你了。
lines.en: You kicked me — I'll remember you.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的长腿。
lines.en: Ow, my long legs.

lines.zh: 我这双腿稳得很，没倒。
lines.en: These legs of mine hold. I'm not down.

lines.zh: 那里是新长出来的，别碰。
lines.en: That part just grew. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 翅膀底下在渗血，不轻。
lines.en: It's bleeding under my wing. Not light.

lines.zh: 我两条腿还站着，别得意。
lines.en: I'm still on both legs. Don't gloat.

lines.zh: 恶地的沙子磨着我的脚趾。
lines.en: Badlands sand grinds my toes.

lines.zh: 是小麦吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that wheat? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你把麦穗举高一点。
lines.en: Hold the wheat up a little higher.

lines.zh: 我吃小麦，但不吃你的手。
lines.en: I eat wheat, not your hand.

lines.zh: 那一把够我吃两口。
lines.en: That handful is two bites for me.

lines.zh: 麦粒掉在地上了，可惜。
lines.en: Wheat grains fell on the ground — a shame.

lines.zh: 你撒一把，我自己啄。
lines.en: Scatter a handful; I'll peck it up myself.

lines.zh: 脖子伸到最长，麦穗进嘴了。
lines.en: Neck at full stretch, the wheat reaches my beak.

lines.zh: 这麦子比我找到的饱满。
lines.en: This wheat is plumper than what I find.

lines.zh: 我要先确认没有陷阱。
lines.en: I need to check there's no trap first.

lines.zh: 你退开，我吃得安心些。
lines.en: Step back and I'll eat more at ease.

lines.zh: 光，把光往这边挪。
lines.en: The light. Move it this way.

lines.zh: 你拿着树苗做什么。
lines.en: What are you doing with that sapling?

lines.zh: 红的果子，我先尝一口。
lines.en: A red fruit — one taste, that's all.

lines.zh: 一捧草籽，够我啄半天。
lines.en: A handful of seeds is half a day's pecking.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，恶地的风都追不上。
lines.en: When I run, the badlands wind lags behind.

lines.zh: 你在倒水？恶地很少见。
lines.en: Pouring water? Rare in the badlands.

lines.zh: 恶地的叶子都朝你那边倾了。
lines.en: The badlands leaves all lean your way.

lines.zh: 那桶水晃，我喉咙在动。
lines.en: That bucket sloshes and my throat moves.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，这两条腿停不下。
lines.en: Once I run, these two legs will not stop.

lines.zh: 恶地的草籽，我一口一啄。
lines.en: One peck for each badland seed.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到了我的胸骨。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my breastbone.

lines.zh: 我一米多高，撞起来不轻。
lines.en: I stand over a meter; my bump isn't light.

lines.zh: 别从背后靠近，我的后踢不长眼。
lines.en: Don't approach from behind; my back kick is blind.

lines.zh: 我把你挤开，是为了护蛋。
lines.en: I shoved you aside to guard the eggs.

lines.zh: 长腿绊了一下，差点摔倒。
lines.en: My long legs tangled; I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我拖在地上的羽毛。
lines.en: You stepped on a feather I dropped.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没让。
lines.en: We collided and neither gave way.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，从你旁边挤过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze past you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，是你的错。
lines.en: That collision was your fault.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压低，从你臂下钻过。
lines.en: I duck my neck and slip under your arm.

lines.zh: 退开，你踩乱我的羽毛。
lines.en: Back off. You've trampled my feathers.

lines.zh: 撞我？我肋下全是硬骨。
lines.en: Bump me? My ribs are all hard bone.

lines.zh: 我不会飞，可这双腿够狠。
lines.en: I can't fly, but these legs are mean.

lines.zh: 慢点，我腿一蹬你就飞。
lines.en: Easy. One kick from these legs and you're airborne.

lines.zh: 我这两条长腿，一蹬就到。
lines.en: These long legs cover it in one kick.

lines.zh: 那是我跑起来的道，让开。
lines.en: That's my running lane. Move.

lines.zh: 你把我的影子踩断了。
lines.en: You broke my shadow in two.

lines.zh: 恶地的碎石硌了我的爪。
lines.en: Badlands gravel is digging into my claws.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛乱了，这比疼难受。
lines.en: My feathers are messed up, and that is worse than pain.

lines.zh: 撞一下，掉三片叶子。
lines.en: One bump, three leaves gone.

lines.zh: 你用小麦喂我，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Feed me wheat and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛比你的亮。
lines.en: My feathers shine brighter than yours.

lines.zh: 我们先在红土上转两圈。
lines.en: Let's circle twice on the red earth first.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，我回你一声。
lines.en: You call once; I answer once.

lines.zh: 蛋要埋在暖一点的土里。
lines.en: The eggs must go in warmer soil.

lines.zh: 我来守夜，你先睡。
lines.en: I'll keep watch; you sleep first.

lines.zh: 别踩那窝，里面有蛋。
lines.en: Don't step on that nest; there are eggs.

lines.zh: 我们的腿一样长，跑起来配。
lines.en: Our legs match; we run well together.

lines.zh: 你啄我的脖子，是同意了吗？
lines.en: You peck my neck — is that a yes?

lines.zh: 等小鸸鹋出来，我带它们走。
lines.en: When the chicks hatch, I'll lead them.

lines.zh: 我这大个子，先跳个舞给你。
lines.en: Big as I am, let me dance for you first.

lines.zh: 恶地的季节短，趁现在。
lines.en: The badlands season is short. Now.

lines.zh: 春天短，我们别磨蹭。
lines.en: Spring is short. Let's not dawdle.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，转两圈。
lines.en: I spread my wings and turn twice.

lines.zh: 恶地的草籽，够我们分着吃。
lines.en: There are enough grass seeds in the badlands to share.

lines.zh: 我在恶地跳一支怪舞。
lines.en: I dance a strange dance in the badlands.

lines.zh: 恶地的雨来得少，我们一起等。
lines.en: Rain is rare in the badlands; we wait together.

lines.zh: 我长脖子伸进灌木，找红土里的东西。
lines.en: My long neck dips into the scrub for red-dirt things.

lines.zh: 我不会飞，可我不怕跑。
lines.en: I cannot fly, but I am not afraid to run.

lines.zh: 恶地的种子，我来守着。
lines.en: The badlands seeds, I will guard them.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起一颗亮石头。
lines.en: I pick up a bright stone in my beak.

lines.zh: 这羽毛是我自己掉的。
lines.en: This feather is one I dropped myself.

lines.zh: 我把它甩到窝边，垫着。
lines.en: I toss it by the nest to line it.

lines.zh: 麦粒一颗一颗捡，很费时间。
lines.en: Picking up wheat grain by grain takes time.

lines.zh: 我叼不住太大的东西。
lines.en: I can't carry anything too large.

lines.zh: 这颗蛋不是我下的，别算我头上。
lines.en: That egg isn't mine; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在草里，回头再吃。
lines.en: I hide it in the grass to eat later.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的东西，我总想啄一下。
lines.en: Shiny things always make me want to peck.

lines.zh: 我低头，用喙拨了拨。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge it with my beak.

lines.zh: 掉了就掉了，我不捡第二次。
lines.en: If it dropped, it dropped; I won't pick it twice.

lines.zh: 这双腿不会飞，踢起来很重。
lines.en: These legs cannot fly, but they kick hard.

lines.zh: 这颗种子，我先啄。
lines.en: I peck this seed first.

lines.zh: 这果子软了，还能吃吗。
lines.en: This fruit's gone soft. Still edible?

lines.zh: 别盯我，我在沙里刨坑。
lines.en: Don't stare. I'm digging in the sand.

lines.zh: 亮石头，我叼回窝里。
lines.en: A shiny stone — I'll carry it to my nest.

lines.zh: 恶地的土，叼不动就放下。
lines.en: Badland dirt. I give up when it will not lift.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，能当肥料。
lines.en: This bone will make good fertilizer.

lines.zh: 落地的草籽，全归我。
lines.en: Seeds on the ground are all mine.

lines.zh: 我捡东西不还的。
lines.en: What I pick up, I keep.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的，是我的了。
lines.en: Shiny. Mine now.

lines.zh: 那边有个骷髅，背着弓。
lines.en: There's a skeleton over there with a bow.

lines.zh: 我讨厌弓弦的声音。
lines.en: I hate the sound of a bowstring.

lines.zh: 草叶晃了一下，里面有东西。
lines.en: The grass blades twitch; something's inside.

lines.zh: 那个举着弓的家伙，我记住了。
lines.en: I've marked that one holding the bow.

lines.zh: 我看见它在瞄准我。
lines.en: I see it taking aim at me.

lines.zh: 有只骷髅走进了恶地。
lines.en: A skeleton walked into the badlands.

lines.zh: 我要先冲过去，别让它拉弦。
lines.en: I need to charge before it draws.

lines.zh: 那根骨头架子，跑得不快。
lines.en: That bag of bones doesn't run fast.

lines.zh: 目标是弓，不是拿弓的人。
lines.en: The target is the bow, not the one holding it.

lines.zh: 它一放箭，我就闪开。
lines.en: When it looses an arrow, I'll dodge.

lines.zh: 碎石缝里的草，都在看你。
lines.en: The grass in the gravel is watching you.

lines.zh: 你惊动了整片林子。
lines.en: You woke the whole grove.

lines.zh: 好，开始吧。
lines.en: Good. Let's begin.

lines.zh: 你惹了鸸鹋，今天算你。
lines.en: You crossed an emu. This one's on you.

lines.zh: 你踩进恶地这块碎石地了。
lines.en: You've stepped onto my badlands gravel.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，就不松。
lines.en: Once fixed, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 叶子都在指你。
lines.en: Every leaf points at you.

lines.zh: 我不会飞，可腿很有力。
lines.en: I cannot fly, but my legs are strong.

lines.zh: 别动，我腿已经抬起来了。
lines.en: Don't move. My leg is already up.

lines.zh: 站住，我一脚就能到。
lines.en: Stand there. One kick and I'm on you.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，爪子抓稳红土。
lines.en: I drop my weight low, claws gripping the red earth.

lines.zh: 它拉弦了，我数着它的动作。
lines.en: It's drawing; I count its movements.

lines.zh: 我往侧面绕，避开箭线。
lines.en: I circle to the side, out of the arrow's line.

lines.zh: 等它射空，我再上。
lines.en: I'll wait for it to miss, then move in.

lines.zh: 爪子一直张着，等它先动。
lines.en: My claws stay open, waiting for it to move first.

lines.zh: 它在后退，我不给它距离。
lines.en: It's backing off; I won't give it room.

lines.zh: 我盯着那根弦，不看箭。
lines.en: I watch the string, not the arrow.

lines.zh: 再近三步，它就来不及了。
lines.en: Three more steps and it'll be too late.

lines.zh: 我故意露个破绽。
lines.en: I'm deliberately showing an opening.

lines.zh: 它转身了，我追上去。
lines.en: It turned away; I'm after it.

lines.zh: 你心跳太快，我听了想笑。
lines.en: Your heart's racing. It's almost funny.

lines.zh: 我讨厌弓，先追弓箭手。
lines.en: I hate bows. I go for the archers first.

lines.zh: 我这长腿一迈就到你面前。
lines.en: One stride and I'm at your face.

lines.zh: 前面是岩坡，你爬不过我。
lines.en: That's a rock slope ahead. You can't outclimb me.

lines.zh: 别停，我这双腿还没热身。
lines.en: Don't stop. My legs aren't even warm.

lines.zh: 这林子每一棵都听我的。
lines.en: Every tree here answers me.

lines.zh: 一步能跨半条沟，看你跑。
lines.en: One stride clears half a gully. Run, then.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土上，我的脚印最乱。
lines.en: On the badlands red dirt, my prints are the messiest.

lines.zh: 你越急，我越稳。
lines.en: The more you rush, the steadier I am.

lines.zh: 我跑起来比马还快。
lines.en: I outrun a horse on my own legs.

lines.zh: 我抬起大爪，往下撕。
lines.en: I raise my big claw and rake downward.

lines.zh: 这一脚踢出去，能踹断骨头。
lines.en: This kick could snap bone.

lines.zh: 我转身用爪子扫它的弓。
lines.en: I spin and rake my claws at its bow.

lines.zh: 它拉住我了，我就啄它的手。
lines.en: It grabbed me; I peck its hand.

lines.zh: 我先跑，跑着跑着回头一击。
lines.en: I run, then wheel around and strike.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比嘴更管用。
lines.en: My claws work better than my beak.

lines.zh: 把它按在红土上，别让它拉弦。
lines.en: Pin it to the red earth so it can't draw.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替被射中的同伴。
lines.en: That one was for the companion it shot.

lines.zh: 它退开几步，我停在原地。
lines.en: It backs off a few steps; I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，羽毛竖了起来。
lines.en: I shake my head and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 别躲，这双长腿追得上。
lines.en: Don't dodge, these long legs keep up.

lines.zh: 一脚下去，你就躺平了。
lines.en: One kick and you're flat.

lines.zh: 刺比枝先到。
lines.en: The thorn arrives before the branch.

lines.zh: 这一脚，能把肋骨踢断。
lines.en: This kick could snap a rib.

lines.zh: 我把你拍进土里。
lines.en: I'll pound you into the soil.

lines.zh: 该结账了，砍树的。
lines.en: Time to pay, woodcutter.

lines.zh: 这一脚踢得比看上去重。
lines.en: That kick landed harder than it looked.

lines.zh: 我抬腿慢，落下来可不慢。
lines.en: I lift my leg slowly. It lands fast.

lines.zh: 我这脚一踹，草丛全倒。
lines.en: One kick and the whole thicket goes down.

lines.zh: 接我一脚，站稳了！
lines.en: Take this kick. Hold on!

lines.zh: 我从恶地的红土里钻出来。
lines.en: I push up out of the badlands' red earth.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的是层层红岩。
lines.en: The first thing I see is banded red rock.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上的土。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off my body.

lines.zh: 长腿还站不太稳。
lines.en: My long legs don't stand steady yet.

lines.zh: 草原的风先吹到我的脖子。
lines.en: The savanna wind hits my neck first.

lines.zh: 我试着跑了两步。
lines.en: I try two running steps.

lines.zh: 远处有一群同伴在啄食。
lines.en: A group of companions forages in the distance.

lines.zh: 我记得这个国家的传说。
lines.en: I remember the legend of that nation.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，又收了起来。
lines.en: I spread my wings, then fold them again.

lines.zh: 这片红土，以后是我的地盘。
lines.en: This red ground is my territory now.

lines.zh: 荒地上，太阳烤得我背发烫。
lines.en: On the badlands, the sun bakes my back.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，我先晒晒背。
lines.en: Day's just breaking. First, some sun on my back.

lines.zh: 恶地的草，我认得。
lines.en: I know the grass of the badlands.

lines.zh: 沙土烫脚，我站起来了。
lines.en: The sand burns my feet. Up I get.

lines.zh: 先找水，再找能啄的虫。
lines.en: Water first, then bugs to peck.

lines.zh: 身上还带着土。
lines.en: Still covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 恶地的风里，有草籽味。
lines.en: The badlands wind carries the smell of seeds.

lines.zh: 我好像长错地方了。
lines.en: I think I grew in the wrong spot.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里爬出来，站稳。
lines.en: I climbed out of the egg. Now I stand.

lines.zh: 恶地的沙土，踩上去咯吱响。
lines.en: Badland sand crunches under my feet.

lines.zh: 这地方亮得刺眼，先适应。
lines.en: This place is glaring. I'll adjust.

lines.zh: 恶地的热风，把我吹醒了。
lines.en: Badlands heat haze woke me up.

lines.zh: 火苗卷到羽毛，焦味很难闻。
lines.en: Flame catches my feathers; the burnt smell is awful.

lines.zh: 火，离我的叶子远点！
lines.en: Fire! Away from my leaves!

lines.zh: 我从岩坡滑下，摔在碎石上。
lines.en: I slid down the rocky slope onto gravel.

lines.zh: 落地真硬，土呢。
lines.en: The ground is hard. Where's soil?

lines.zh: 水没到脖子，我扑腾着往岸上爬。
lines.en: Water reaches my neck; I thrash toward shore.

lines.zh: 憋，我居然会憋。
lines.en: Drowning. So I can drown.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，羽毛里全是土。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, dirt in my feathers.

lines.zh: 我跑得快，炸得更快。
lines.en: I run fast. The blast is faster.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的腿，留了道口子。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my leg and left a gash.

lines.zh: 箭扎在羽毛里，真疼。
lines.en: An arrow in my feathers. That stings.

lines.zh: 药水味让我头晕，脚都站不稳。
lines.en: Potion fumes make me dizzy; my feet won't steady.

lines.zh: 一股怪力顺着腿往上爬。
lines.en: Something strange crawls up my legs.

lines.zh: 草籽都干了，我啄不动。
lines.en: The seeds are all dry; I can't peck them.

lines.zh: 没有光，我快撑不住。
lines.en: No light. I'm fading.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边的枯树上。
lines.en: Lightning struck the dead tree beside me.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，羽毛全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck and every feather stood up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我只能乱蹬。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I can only kick at nothing.

lines.zh: 下面没有土。
lines.en: There's no soil below.
